text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track progress. Breaking a project into milestones makes it easier to monitor smaller achievements along the way. Deliverables should also be clearly defined so everyone understands what needs to be completed. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. When all parties agree on the goals from the start, the project runs more smoothly and avoids misunderstandings. Together, these practices create a solid foundation for managing any project effectively.
